title: Synthetic order service: portable System Contract proposal
scope: Illustrative requirements/behaviors and platform assessment; no actual application was imported, executed or approved.
claim_policy: Origin and verification are independent LSM provenance axes; verification never changes origin or implies approval. Known origins have a nonempty source. Unavailable facts have status unknown, null provenance and an unknown_reason, not a new origin. Verification is scoped to an explicit method, immutable artifact/run identity, environment and coverage. Reading documentation observes a documented statement, not application behavior or approved intent. This example contains no verified provenance or performed application observation.

requirements.statement: Only an authenticated customer may read or change that customer's orders.
acceptance_criteria: An unauthenticated request is denied without disclosing order data.
A different customer cannot observe or change another customer's order.

requirements.statement: An eligible customer can cancel an order before dispatch without causing duplicate refunds.
acceptance_criteria: After successful cancellation, a repeated request does not cause an additional refund.
Cancellation racing with dispatch follows a policy approved before implementation.

preconditions: An order belongs to a customer; identity and ownership policy await approval.
behaviors.stimulus: A customer requests another customer's order.
behaviors.observable_response: Access is denied without leaking protected order details.
behaviors.failure_behavior: Exact protocol error mapping remains unspecified, not inferred from an implementation.

verification.coverage: No application tests or identity configuration inspected.

preconditions: An authenticated owner has an order not yet dispatched.
behaviors.stimulus: The same cancellation request is submitted twice.
behaviors.observable_response: The approved result identifies cancellation without a second refund.
behaviors.observable_side_effects: One approved cancellation/refund outcome; retry and transaction boundaries await review.
behaviors.failure_behavior: Dispatch races, payment failures and offline retries are blocking unknowns.

verification.coverage: Proposed examples only; no universal exactly-once or equivalence proof.

interfaces.compatibility_policy: Propose additive changes; existing consumer requirements must be identified and approved.

interfaces.unknown_reason: No actual payment provider, protocol or interface artifact was inspected.
interfaces.compatibility_policy: Inventory provider refund/idempotency behavior and failure contract before approval.

deployment_observations.limit: Reports official documentation, not the synthetic application's current platform.

conflict_representation.rule: A conflict requires evidence of an unmet mandatory capability. Unknown is an assessment status, not an origin: use null provenance plus unknown_reason when the fact is unavailable. Unknown blocks approval where material, and is not promoted to conflict or satisfied without evidence. Known origins use LSM provenance with independent origin and verification.
conflict_representation.exception_policy: Only a human-approved, versioned requirement exception can accept a conflict; record approver, rationale, affected requirements and supersession. This example has no approved exceptions.
